intent.outcome: A fresh agent can see the current task gate and the next safe action without replaying chat history.
scope: Add deterministic context and status views
Allow an explicitly requested local transition write
non_goals: Choose product scope without a human

decisions.question: Should lifecycle validation remain read-only by default?
decisions.answer: Yes. A transition write requires an explicit --write flag and a local task record.

acceptance.statement: The context view reports the active task and its next legal gate without changing the task record.
acceptance.risk: A misleading cold-start view can send a fresh agent into the wrong work or gate.

acceptance.statement: An explicit transition write changes only the task status and preserves a private local record.
acceptance.risk: An implicit or unsafe write could overwrite concurrent work or expose task contents.

slices.title: Cold-start views and explicit local transition writes

review.summary: The implementation stays within the approved slice; validation remains deterministic and writes are explicit.

handoff.outcome: The workflow kernel is ready for a human-controlled handoff after the final gate.
handoff.next_action: Review the pilot output, then decide whether to merge and release the workflow slice.
